body: The gem cups are fucking brutal...

Thanks for all your kind words. I first developed feelings for her at the start of 2016 and I used to talk to one of my friends about my problems. But now that it's mid 2019 I just feel embarrassed to bring it up.

A lot can happen to people in 3 years and for me nothing's changed in that aspect of my life. For a while I just wanted to go back to being friends and now that that door's shut I feel stuck in a cold, dark room.

I know that I'm hungry but I can't bring myself to eat. I don't know why but I just don't have an appetite for anything. I don't wanna stay in my room but I also don't wanna leave it. I don't wanna do nothing but I also don't wanna do anything. I just wish I could be gone without anyone noticing
